scope: Manufacturer documentation/CAD/published ROS plus original AnyDex paper. No controller/source edits, hardware connection, network training or physical execution.

known.finding: Force70 encodes70% requested closing grip setting, not70N or a joint torque.
known.boundary: The percent-to-newton curve is not specified. Do not assume70%=0.7*65N; gap, finger configuration, contact location, firmware and control mode are not calibrated.

known.finding: The manufacturer legacy driver used forDH3 has SetTargetSpeed(int) as a no-op returningtrue.
known.boundary: This is proven for the pinned2021ROS implementation, not all firmware. AnyDex independently writes0x0104; no recovered primary mapping proves this controlsDH3 speed or converts100 to rad/s. Manufacturer0.7s is a nominal minimum/full-stroke time, not a joint velocity parameter.

known.finding: ManufacturerDH3 driver clamps position0–95 and force15–90, while its header/manual describe0–100 and20–100%; AnyDex sends70/100 without this driver.
known.boundary: Force70 is within both reported ranges; the differing limits prevent assuming a universal firmware scale.

known.finding: OfficialDH3 URDF has the same simplified cross-finger mimics asAnyDex, but no calibrated transmission/differential/spring/damping control. ItsGazebo launch only spawns thisURDF and publishes a calibrated flag.
known.boundary: Official provenance does not make these mimic relations a validated loaded physical model. No releasedDH3 simulator fixture/force calibration was found in the pinned257-entry tree.

known.finding: CAD contains three eachCRANK/DRIVE/ADAPTIVE_LINK as separate mechanism components, in addition to the named proximal/distal/parallel/base parts. Nine mechanism components are not separate links in the13-entityURDF.
known.boundary: STEP contains noREVOLUTE_PAIR/KINEMATIC/GEAR_PAIR/SCREW_PAIR entities. Part names/placements are not mating constraints, spring laws or motor force maps. STEP and URDF have different dates, and no revision-matched assembly registration has been completed. The product tree alone does not establish entity correspondence or the mechanism under load.

evidence.finding: Same-assignee3-finger patent: one screw/nut slider synchronously translates3drive rods; another motor rotates2rods oppositely.

Related same-assignee patent: a passive sliding member with elastic element in the finger parallel linkage; proximal blocking can lead to continued distal closure; paragraph0067 includes a3-finger embodiment.

known.boundary: These are original patent disclosures by the vendor, not certification that the commercialDH3 unit inAnyDex uses that exact embodiment. They support a common linear input plus internal passive adaptation candidate, not an arbitrary free cross-finger differential.

known.finding: Paper reports4DoF/2motors/underactuation and preshapes before force-limited closure.
known.boundary: Neither the paper paragraph, simplifiedURDF, norCAD explicitly identifies four independent physical coordinates. Do not pick which twogear rows to remove from the4DoF label alone.

Product page current specification and2020/2021documents may refer to different revisions. Neither proves the paper device force70 curve or true moving inertia; do not rescale the.448kgCAD model to1.68kg without component mass evidence.

unknown_parameters: the paper4DoF coordinate definitions and loaded passive-motion topology
screw lead, gear ratio, efficiency and actuator current/torque relationship
force-percent versus fingertip force versus gape/configuration/contact location
speed100 command semantics in the actualAnyDex firmware and load-dependent timing
moving component inertia and how omitted mechanism parts contribute

minimum_credible_next_step.current_action: Measure the unchanged simulation-port response in the parent five frozen force fixtures. Record per-contact force, finger pose, target/measured closure, torque saturation, gear reaction and force-versus-gap; retain all outcomes.
minimum_credible_next_step.claim_allowed: Measured response of the declared simulator, possibly compared to manufacturer nominal bounds.
minimum_credible_next_step.claim_not_allowed: Hardware calibration, recovered firmware, validated passive mechanism or reproduced paper physical success.
minimum_credible_next_step.model_direction: Preserve verified preshape geometry and common drive input. If a new passive model is later built, derive each finger closed-chain geometry from sourceCAD/patent and identify passive elastic/sliding behavior; do not merely remove cross-finger gears or apply.6Nm independently to3fingers.
minimum_credible_next_step.identification_requirement: True calibration needs measured force/time/deformation curves or revision-matched vendor curves. Without them, all chosen compliant parameters remain explicit simulation assumptions; fitting grasp success is not identification.

download_summary.official_plugin_archive: Downloaded and listed only; containedRAR/native binaries, none executed or extracted into sharedenvironment. No further download planned.
